offline_integrated_campaign.scope: Standalone Laplace APIs, memory, corpus/RAG, repository context, rules, events, checkpoints, compaction, ACI, skills, hooks, consolidation, scheduling, serving, model policy, reliability, security, operator and Zetsu unit/integration fixtures.

compileall.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m compileall -q src tests

verified: Local UI/API and operator surfaces with localhost and ownership boundaries
Episodic/semantic/project memory with contradiction, supersession, update/delete and corrupt-storage fail-closed behavior
Personal Corpus/RAG permissions, provenance, hash-based ingestion and traversal/symlink/network restrictions
Repository map/context, bounded deterministic ACI, Python/SystemVerilog patch applicability and verification gates
Append-only events and trajectories, derived checkpoints, replay, crash/restart and resumable state validation
Logical long-context planning/compaction, rules hierarchy, governed skills, hooks and shadow idle consolidation
Single-GPU-aware serial and queued logical subagent scheduling with cancellation, OOM recovery, fairness and owner/depth gates
Zetsu retrieval/delegation/verification/result lifecycle fixtures and bounded large-result handling
not_live_certified: Live model generation quality, throughput, latency and VRAM measurements
Target-laptop endurance, file-descriptor/lock/disk-growth and repeated live-session measurements
A Codex-controlled mutating task using Laplace to modify this worktree

zetsu_and_runtime.repository_agent_proof: Passed bounded read-only agent_task without per_user_worktree_quota. A later mutating delegation hit the deterministic stale-target zetsu_agent_apply_target_not_clean guard; no unsafe workaround was used.

rtl_and_routing.control: CodeV-R1-7B BF16 control run not claimed because the required candidate comparison could not be formed.
rtl_and_routing.routing_decision: Keep the certified CodeV rollback route; do not promote SiliconMind. Current runtime remains nocodev by explicit topology choice.
rtl_and_routing.measurements: No A/B correctness, pass-by-3, repair, tokens, latency, throughput, VRAM, OOM or co-residency values fabricated.

performance_and_endurance.v1_baseline: Inherited from the certified G0 artifact; not rerun.
performance_and_endurance.reason: The local certified model/toolchain and target-hardware conditions required for live generation and endurance evidence were not available.

limitations: The final verdict is limited to research readiness; it is not a claim of controlled single-user or general production readiness.
The mandatory RTL A/B remains a genuine local artifact/toolchain blocker documented in the G11 certification.
No cloud inference, remote document upload, telemetry, paid API, paywall bypass or production-source modification was used.
Logical callable subagent state is not durably replayed after scheduler restart; durable whole-agent recovery remains in the repaired production control plane.
Socket-based tests require host permission because the restricted shell denies socket creation; the selected suite passed with that permission.

production.description: Immutable promoted control plane; no v2 source was written there.
